name: fib_le_pow
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)
statement: theorem fib_le_pow (n : Nat) : fib n ≤ 2 ^ n
proofs:
induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => decide
    | succ n => cases n with
      | zero => decide
      | succ n =>
        have h0 := ih n (by omega)
        have h1 := ih (n + 1) (by omega)
        simp only [fib, Nat.pow_succ] at *
        omega
  have pair (k : Nat) : fib k ≤ 2 ^ k ∧ fib (k + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => decide
    | succ k ih =>
      constructor
      · exact ih.2
      · simp only [fib, Nat.pow_succ] at *; omega
  exact (pair n).1
strategies: Strong induction using bounds at both smaller indices.
Ordinary induction on a strengthened pair of consecutive bounds.
